name: agent-team-os
description: Build and run your own AI agent team, derived from your own week rather than shipped fixed. /ledger interviews you about where your time actually goes; /match turns those numbers into a proposed team and an honest gaps list; /onboard scaffolds the repo in twelve resumable phases across six stages; /routines and /arm make sure every job either rings or says in writing why it is off. Plus /new-agent, /new-skill, /new-workflow, /add-pack, /audit and /onboard-ceo. Level 2 of The Claude Code Workshop.

plugins.name: agent-team-os
plugins.description: Hire workers, not tools. /ledger measures your week in your own words. /match derives the team those numbers justify and lists what nothing here does. /onboard builds the repo end to end, from a blank GitHub account to a dashboard on your phone. /routines snapshots what is really scheduled on your account and /arm settles every job into armed or off-with-a-reason, so nothing is left pretending to run. /new-agent adds a specialist, /new-workflow turns a conversation into a named scheduled job, /new-skill adds one named capability without scheduling anything, /add-pack installs a ready-made one, /audit says what is working, what is stale and what was never set up, and /onboard-ceo builds a CEO team ending in a Monday Brief.
